parse.name: flowchart-subgraphs
parse.source:
---
title: Deploy pipeline
---
flowchart TB
    subgraph ci [Continuous integration]
      direction LR
      lint[Lint] --> test[Test]
      test --> build[Build image]
    end
    subgraph cd["Delivery"]
      stage[Staging] --> prod[Production]
    end
    build --> stage
    dev((Developer)) --> ci
    prod -. rollback .-> stage
    classDef danger fill:#fbe6df,stroke:#b53d22,color:#b53d22
    class prod danger
    style dev fill:#14365a,stroke:#14365a
    click prod "https://example.com/prod" "Open"
    linkStyle 0 stroke:#12806f,stroke-width:2px

parse.name: state
parse.source:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Idle
    Idle --> Running : start
    Running --> Paused : pause
    Paused --> Running : resume
    Running --> Done : finish
    state Running {
      [*] --> Fetching
      Fetching --> Working
      Working --> [*]
    }
    state check <<choice>>
    Done --> check
    check --> [*] : ok
    check --> Idle : retry
    note right of Paused : Waiting for the user
    Done : All steps finished

parse.name: sequence
parse.source:
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor U as User
    participant W as Web app
    participant API
    participant DB as Database
    U->>W: Open conversation
    W->>+API: GET /chats/42
    API->>DB: SELECT messages
    DB-->>API: rows
    alt cache hit
      API-->>W: 200 (cached)
    else cache miss
      API->>API: Render markdown
      API-->>-W: 200 OK
    end
    loop Every 30s
      W-)API: heartbeat
    end
    Note over W,API: Live updates via SSE
    W--xU: Connection lost

parse.name: complex
parse.source:
flowchart TD
    U[User sends message] --> R{Route request}
    R -->|chat| C[Conversation service]
    R -->|mission| M[Mission scheduler]
    R -->|plugin| P[Plugin runtime]
    C --> Q[(Queue)]
    M --> Q
    P --> Q
    Q --> W1[Worker 1]
    Q --> W2[Worker 2]
    Q --> W3[Worker 3]
    W1 & W2 & W3 --> A{All succeeded?}
    A -- yes --> D[Deliver result]
    A -- no --> X[Retry with backoff]
    X --> Q
    D --> N([Notify user])
    C -.-> L[Audit log]
    M -.-> L

parse.name: state-fork
parse.source:
stateDiagram
    direction LR
    [*] --> fork_state
    state fork_state <<fork>>
    fork_state --> A
    fork_state --> B
    state join_state <<join>>
    A --> join_state
    B --> join_state
    join_state --> [*]
    state "Waiting for input" as W
    A --> W
    note left of W
      Multi line
      note body
    end note

parse.name: sequence-blocks
parse.source:
sequenceDiagram
    title: Checkout
    participant C as Client
    participant S as Server
    C->>S: POST /orders
    activate S
    par Charge card
      S->>S: charge()
    and Reserve stock
      S-)S: reserve()
    end
    critical Persist
      S->>S: commit
    option Timeout
      S--xC: 504
    end
    rect rgb(191, 223, 255)
      S-->>C: 201 Created
    end
    deactivate S
    break when cancelled
      C->S: cancel
    end
    opt Receipt
      S--)C: email
    end
    Note left of C: Done
